source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, IPNI original-publication links, World Flora Online 2026
synonym_and_rank_caution: POWO's S. elliottii has only two formal synonyms: Chrysopogon elliottii (homotypic) and Sorghastrum apalachicolense (heterotypic). IPNI's Andropogon nutans sensu Elliott non L. is a historical misapplied usage, while A. nutans L. belongs to S. nutans. Andropogon elliottii Chapm. and Sorghum elliottii Kuntze belong to Anatherum ternarium.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; target-zone status UNRESOLVED and all county flags unchanged
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — source-labelled only, no individual morphological/voucher certification
install_decision: Keep existing S. elliottii canonical card. No installation, canonical species edit, photos, genus/family lessons, county range, or Pages writes.

decisions.subject: Sorghastrum elliottii (C.Mohr) Nash
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain as accepted Poaceae species at species rank, with (C.Mohr) Nash authorship
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP recognizes distinct species; IPNI links Mohr's basionym to Nash's 1912 combination.

decisions.subject: Chrysopogon elliottii C.Mohr (1897)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic basionym of S. elliottii
decisions.detail: Mohr 1897, Bull. Torrey Bot. Club 24(1):21; IPNI's nomenclatural link.

decisions.subject: Sorghastrum apalachicolense D.W.Hall (1982)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as heterotypic synonym of S. elliottii, not an independent species
decisions.detail: POWO lists this among two synonyms, heterotypic.

decisions.subject: Sorghastrum nutans (L.) Nash
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain as separately accepted species, not synonym of S. elliottii

decisions.subject: Andropogon nutans L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map Linnaean name to S. nutans, NOT to S. elliottii
decisions.detail: This author-qualified basionym belongs to S. nutans.

decisions.subject: Andropogon nutans sensu Elliott (1816), non L.
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as historically misapplied taxon concept cited in Mohr's protologue, not a formal accepted synonym
decisions.detail: IPNI explicitly says Mohr's Chrysopogon elliottii was sp. nov. for Elliott's non-Linnaean usage.

decisions.subject: Sorghastrum secundum (Elliott) Nash
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species from S. elliottii and S. nutans
decisions.detail: POWO separately accepts the species despite similar names and one-sided panicle traits.

decisions.subject: Andropogon secundus Elliott (1821)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to S. secundum as homotypic basionym, not S. elliottii

decisions.subject: Andropogon elliottii Chapm. (1860), nom. illeg. superfl.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to accepted Anatherum ternarium, not S. elliottii
decisions.detail: Same epithet elliottii does not establish species identity; POWO marks illegitimate superfluous.

decisions.subject: Sorghum elliottii Kuntze (1891), nom. illeg. superfl.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to accepted Anatherum ternarium, not S. elliottii
decisions.detail: IPNI links Kuntze's combination to Chapman; POWO synonym list for A. ternarium.

decisions.subject: Auto-merge S. elliottii with S. nutans because Elliott used Andropogon nutans
decisions.detail: IPNI's 'sensu Elliott, non L.' is a misapplication, not the Linnaean type.

decisions.subject: Treat Andropogon elliottii Chapm. or Sorghum elliottii Kuntze as synonyms of S. elliottii
decisions.detail: Both Chapman/Kuntze name concepts belong to Anatherum ternarium.

decisions.subject: Individual S. elliottii source-labelled gallery photographs/specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve exact-individual identification HOLD; no new determination
decisions.detail: No same-plant voucher or independently confirmed diagnostic rootstock, awn and spikelet measurement in taxonomy-only run.

decisions.subject: Hybrid, introgression or cultivated ancestry of individual Sorghastrum specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve ancestry HOLD; no hybrid assignment
decisions.detail: No primary genetic or breeding evidence establishing hybrid ancestry of individual learner specimens.

decisions.subject: Unqualified historical 'Andropogon nutans' specimen label
decisions.proposed_decision: Leave exact historical concept unresolved until author, date, voucher or source context known
decisions.detail: Linnaean name maps to S. nutans but Elliott's non-Linnaean application prompted Mohr's S. elliottii; bare label is insufficient.

decisions.subject: Secondary citations of 'Andropogon nutans Muhl. (1817)' as synonym of S. elliottii
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not accept without original Muhlenberg citation and author-qualified nomenclatural verification
decisions.detail: This phrasing appears in secondary aggregations but is not among POWO's two formal synonyms; requires original publication and concept inspection.
